body:
From I.S.A.I.F.
by Dr. Theodore Kascynski

15. Leftists tend to hate anything that has an image of being strong, good and
successful. They hate America, they hate Western civilization, they hate white
males, they hate rationality. The reasons that leftists give for hating the
West, etc. clearly do not correspond with their real motives. They SAY they
hate the West because it is warlike, imperialistic, sexist, ethnocentric and so
forth, but where these same faults appear in socialist countries or in
primitive cultures, the leftist finds excuses for them, or at best he
GRUDGINGLY admits that they exist; whereas he ENTHUSIASTICALLY points out (and
often greatly exaggerates) these faults where they appear in Western
civilization. Thus it is clear that these faults are not the leftist's real
motive for hating America and the West. He hates America and the West because
they are strong and successful. 

==================================

Kurt Cobain spews anti-white massochistic platitudes:

"My wife challenges injustice and the reason her character has been so severely
attacked is because she chooses not to function the way the white corporate man
insists.  His rules for women involve her being submissive, quiet, and
non-challenging.  When she doesn't follow his rules, the threatened man (who,
incidentally, owns an army of devoted traitor women) gets scared."

Response to Shadow:

1.  I find it sickening that attacking Western Civilization, and particularly
white males, has become fashionable. 

2. I directly quoted the article as I found it inside the "Incesticide" cover. 
He apparently purposely mispelled his name ["Kurdt"] all over the CD, and I
don't know the reason why.

3. Because people of my nationality committed slavery hundreds of years ago
does not mean that I personally condone it.  For you to suggest that I am
responsible for what Spanish slaveowners did hundreds of years ago is like
suggesting that all black males should be punished when one rapes and murders. 


Are you also suggesting that because I have some Chinese ancestry that I should
pay restitution to the Tibetans and others the Chinese are said to have
oppressed, i.e. Koreans?  What about my Arab ancestry: Should I pay restitution
to the Slavs for the Arabic enslavement of them in ancient times?  Moreover,
should I pay the price for the bombings in Kenya and Tanzania because Arabs are
said to have participated in the act?

BTW, I'd like to know where your ancestors are from; I'm sure we can find some
flaws that people of your race/ethnicity have committed sometime in history. 
In accordance with your logic, you would have to receive the some of the blame.

Pyro
